name: mstack-claude-led-review
description: Claude Code coordinator workflow for delivering a plan folder, a list of issues, or one larger task in a repository: Claude Code leads and its writer lanes edit in isolated worktrees (or one branch in Single mode), tracks each item as Open, In progress or Closed, gets read-only review from the other installed vendor that mstack-vendors offers (codex, or a fallback review), integrates, and delivers one pull request with serialized CI. Runs in Claude Code only.
